_comment: GENERATED corpus — each vector's `expect` (normalized outbound forward sequence + relayed/provider-error responses) is produced by running the browser reference interpreter (frontend/src/lib/refresh/program-interpreter.ts) over the authored `program` + `broker_script`. Do not hand-edit `expect`; regenerate with `make gen-vectors` (UPDATE_VECTORS=1). Loaded in lockstep by all three relay test suites, each feeding `broker_script` at its own mock seam. `expect.responses[*].kind` is `relayed` (status/request_url/body_b64/signature/headers asserted byte-exact) or `provider_error` (status + decoded `error` asserted; `request_url` intentionally omitted — its sentinel host is per-impl). See test-vectors/README.md.

vectors.name: extract-stringify-shapes
vectors._comment: Pins the interpreter's JS-String() coercion of every extracted value shape — arrays (join with ','), objects ('[object Object]'), an all-null array (empty string, so its query param is dropped), and ECMA-262 number notation (decimal through (1e-6, 1e21), unpadded exponents, shortest-digits zero-extension above 2^53) — plus the query percent-encoding of the substituted values, and exponent overflow (`1e400` is VALID JSON that parses to Infinity, so it never reaches a non-standard-constant guard; String() spells it 'Infinity', not the host language's 'inf').

vectors.name: extract-undecodable-body
vectors._comment: A 2xx whose body is valid base64 of non-JSON, on a step declaring extract rules. The relayed 200 is still emitted verbatim, then a 502 provider-error terminates the run: the second step must never forward. Guards the silent `parsed = {}` fallback that used to write '' per rule.

Each vector below is an input the three relays used to DISAGREE on, so each pins agreement the old corpus could not: its only invalid-body vector was valid-base64-of-non-JSON, and the only invalid-base64 test anywhere (macOS's) used '!!!not-base64!!!' -- the single input all three already rejected. Contract = the App Server's own b64decode(validate=True), plus strict UTF-8, no BOM, no lone surrogate, and a depth cap. 'e30=!!': accepted by the CLI, rejected by atob and Swift.

The CLI must anchor with \Z.
